// diagnostic

E0211

`~x` on a value that can't be copied — a function, a trait value, or a type Jet doesn't know how to duplicate (D-SHAPE-COPY1=A, supersedes D-CAP2/D-MEM1/S4)

What

`~x` on a value that can't be copied — a function, a trait value, or a type Jet doesn't know how to duplicate (D-SHAPE-COPY1=A, supersedes D-CAP2/D-MEM1/S4)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0211

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0211: tests/ui/copy_verb_not_cloneable.stderr.

Error [E0211]: `fn(Int) Int` can't be copied
  --> tests/ui/copy_verb_not_cloneable.jet:3:10
    |
  3 |     g :: ~f
    |          ^^
 Why: copy needs a value made only of duplicable parts; this type holds something Jet can't duplicate — a function value, a trait value, or a type from outside Jet
 Fix: move it instead with the move marker `^` (`^name` if this is its last use), or change the type so every part can be copied
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0211
